name: Profilarr
description: Hardware-family video profiles with codec-only video overrides and independent audio transcoding overrides.
author: Tw1zT3d2four7

fields.label: Profile Name Prefix *
fields.description: Base name used for the generated Dispatcharr Stream Profile.

fields.label: Hardware / Video Profile
fields.description: Select the video encoder family. Profilarr validates that the selected encoder is usable when the profile is applied.

fields.label: Video Transcoding Override
fields.description: Select the video codec. Profilarr automatically maps it to the encoder for the selected hardware/video profile.

fields.label: Audio Transcoding Override
fields.description: Independent of the selected video hardware profile.

fields.label: Set as Systemwide Default Profile
fields.description: Automatically sets the generated profile as the Dispatcharr default.

actions.label: Generate and Overwrite Profile
actions.description: Validate the selected hardware-specific encoder, resolve the video codec, generate the wrapper, and create the active Stream Profile.

actions.label: Refresh Profilarr
actions.description: Regenerate all five wrapper scripts and refresh FFmpeg/hardware detection.
